records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Sam replied positively on day 5 saying the first project is "starting to click" [email:b98f2c05], first_project reached day 0 and one invite sent — real momentum, no tickets or blockers. But key_milestone still unreached after 6 days with 8 left, and prior nudges [email:345773c8, email:c40700f4] didn't convert it.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click — thanks for the update.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the usual next step is getting your team's real tasks in alongside you. I noticed one invite has gone out; teammates can also be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next with you.

Best,
Chidi
